name: Jie Yuan Ren
source:
A girl x girl romance adventure game about being a jie yuan ren (a person who separates others' fated ones).

[Translated from [url=https://undine-maat.itch.io/1318]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款以「解緣人」——拆散他人命定緣分之人——為題材的女女戀愛冒險遊戲。

[譯自[url=https://undine-maat.itch.io/1318]itch.io[/url]]
